title: My latest gameplay trailer
author: BestStorage6608
selftext: Been working on this for nearly a year now using ai tools in every aspect to help me.   Have a free demo on steam.  Just finished making this new trailer and wanted to share.  Using claude, and open ai in godot.  AI Built custom tools for me to hand tune everything, AI gets the first pass to implement what I want then I typically have to tune it.   I'll answer any questions, Id love to hear feedback.  Will ignore unconstructive ai slop comments.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Nice thought I do feel there needs to be a little polishing on the UI aspect especially in custom art department. Right now seems like entire Ui is done by code only without any generated art like borders, button textures etc

replies.author: BestStorage6608
replies.body: Ya agreed been struggling with a design i like on ui.  I want it to be simple but agree especially on button structure and ui code borders.

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body:
Depending on what AI you use you can experiment a bit. Astra is capable doing it solo, but Claude can do it if you provide openAI api key to it with some credits 🤷‍♂️ 

Then you tweak it from there

replies.author: BestStorage6608
replies.body: I have max accounts on both.   Having astra review now.  Appreciate you calling this out its an area that is definitely weak.
